title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: David Montgomery quiet in Week 3 loss
items.desc: David Montgomery rushed for 33 yards on 11 carries in a 19-17 loss to the Colts. He caught both targets for 15 yards.
items.impact: Montgomery continues to struggle, tallying 43 rushing yards on 17 carries over the last two games. The veteran also saw Woody Marks come into the game on a short-yardage touchdown run in the forth quarter. Montgomery and the Texans will take on the Cowboys in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kenneth Walker III reaches end zone twice in Week 3 win over Dolphins
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 18 times for 70 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for three yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Walker III has gotten off to an impactful start to the season out of the Kansas City backfield, recording multiple touchdowns in two of the first three contests. The running back remains a dynamic option as part of a revamped Chiefs offensive attack for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: C.J. Stroud struggles in Week 3 loss
items.desc: C.J. Stroud completed 16-of-27 passes for 127 yards and a touchdown in a 19-17 loss to the Colts. He added 10 rushing yards on two attempts.
items.impact: Stroud and the Houston offense continued to struggle without Nico Collins in the lineup. For the second straight season, Stroud and the Texans have struggled early in the season, starting the year 0-3. The team will look to bounce back in Week 4 against Dallas.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II tosses two touchdowns in Week 3 win
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II completed 20-of-24 pass attempts for 246 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing once for one yard in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Mahomes II continues a dynamic start to the season behind center, posting two or more touchdowns in each of the first three games. The superstar quarterback has turned back the clock for head coach Andy Reid to begin the season, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3 win
items.desc: The Steelers D/ST allowed 27 points, 282 passing yards, and 83 rushing yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: The Steelers' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery in the win Sunday. The fumble recovery came on the final drive for the Bengals to help seal the win for the Steelers. The defense will now prepare for the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Travis Kelce finds end zone in Week 3 win over Dolphins
items.desc: Travis Kelce hauled in both of his targets for 59 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Kelce has been impactful to begin the season, recording over 55 receiving yards in each of the first three contests. The veteran tight end has turned back the clock as part of a revamped Chiefs offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chris Boswell prefect in Week 3 win
items.desc: Chris Boswell connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Boswell had a much needed bounce back performance after missing kicks in each of his first two games. The veteran made field goals from 33, 36, and 44 yards out to help pace the Steelers to a win. Boswell and the Steelers will take on the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Darnell Washington hauls in three passes in Week 3
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-4 targets for 67 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Washington saw the bulk of his production come on a 47-yard reception. The 25-year-old continues to compete with Pat Freiermuth for targets, with neither option being trustworthy heading into a Week 4 matchup with the Browns.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rashee Rice leads pass-catchers in Week 3 win over Dolphins
items.desc: Rashee Rice hauled in seven of his team-high nine targets for 88 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Rice has heated up in the Kansas City offense of late, posting over 80 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The wideout remains one of the more dynamic pass-catching options in the Chiefs passing attack moving forward, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Pat Freiermuth hauls in two passes in Week 3
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-4 targets for 30 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Freiermuth has yet to find consistent success this season, and has seen his production dip each week since the season opener. The 27-year-old veteran will continue to compete with Darnell Washington for targets as the Steelers take on the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Xavier Worthy quiet in Week 3 win
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: Worthy was bottled up by a surprising Miami defensive effort Sunday, finishing with less than three receptions for the first time in three contests. The wideout has struggled to offer fantasy managers a reliable pass-catching option to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ben Skowronek finds the end zone in Week 3 win
items.desc: Ben Skowronek caught his lone target for 23 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: The 29-year-old veteran made the most of his lone target Sunday. Fantasy managers can leave Skowronek on the waiver wire for now.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. quiet in Week 3 win
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. caught 2-of-5 targets for 16 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Pittman was making his return from a foot injury that sidelined him in Week 2. The expectation is that Pittman would immediately eat into Roman Wilson's playing time, but Wilson turned in a 3-60-1 performance in the win. Fantasy managers may want to avoid Pittman in Week 4 against the Browns.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Germie Bernard held to one target in Week 3
items.desc: Germie Bernard caught his lone target for 14 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Bernard saw his target share free fall to just one target after seeing eight last week against the Patriots. The 22-year-old should remain out of lineups until us usage becomes more clear.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Roman Wilson finds the end zone in Week 3 win
items.desc: Roman Wilson caught 3-of-6 targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Wilson was expected to potentially see his playing time fall with the return of Michael Pittman, but the 25-year-old tallied his first touchdown of the season and a season high in receiving yards. Wilson will look to build on this performance against the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: DK Metcalf hauls in first TD pass in Week 3 win
items.desc: DK Metcalf caught 3-of-5 targets for 31 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Metcalf found the end zone on a six-yard connection with Aaron Rodgers in the third quarter. The yardage totals and receptions have not been there for Metcalf yet this season, but he will look for an uptick in production against the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emmett Johnson sees six touches in Week 3
items.desc: Emmett Johnson rushed six times for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 25 rushing yards in each of the first three contests. The running back remains more of a handcuff option for Kenneth Walker owners ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jaylen Warren excellent in Week 3 win
items.desc: Jaylen Warren rushed for 127 yards on 17 carries in a 30-27 win over the Bengals. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 49 yards.
items.impact: Warren averaged 7.5 yards per carry and he dominated the rushing attempts with Rico Dowdle (toe) inactive Sunday. With the Steelers taking on the Browns on Thursday, Warren could be in line for a similar workload if Dowdle is unable to play.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Aaron Rodgers tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 win
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers completed 19-of-34 passes for 292 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
items.impact: Rodgers turned in his best performance of the season so far, averaging 8.6 yards per pass attempt in the win. He was able to find Roman Wilson, DK Metcalf, and Ben Skowronek for his three touchdown passes. Rodgers and the Steelers will look to build on this strong performance against the Browns in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Noah Gray catches three passes in Week 3 win
items.desc: Noah Gray caught all three of his targets for 39 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Gray has struggled to make an impact in the Kansas City passing attack to begin the season, finishing with less than 40 receiving yards in each of the first three contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 divisional contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Bengals D/ST allows 30 points in Week 3 loss
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 30 points, 292 passing yards, and 138 rushing yards in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
items.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in loss Sunday. They struggled to stop Jaylen Warren on the ground, as he averaged 7.5 yards per carry on the day. The defense will have a tough matchup against a strong Jacksonville offense in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyquan Thornton catches two passes in Week 3
items.desc: Tyquan Thornton caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Thornton has seen minimal involvement in the Kansas City offense to begin the season, posting two targets or less in two of the first three games. The wideout remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 3
items.desc: Evan McPherson connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and all three extra point attempts in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
items.impact: McPherson continues to provide the Bengals with a steady leg on special teams, as he has yet to miss a kick so far this season. The 27-year-old will look to continue his strong start to the season against the Jaguars in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Mike Gesicki finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
items.impact: Gesicki had a much needed bounce back performance after failing to record a target in Week 2. He tallied his second touchdown of the season on a 25-yard touchdown reception early in the fourth quarter. Gesicki will look to build on this performance in Week 4 against Jacksonville.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jalen Royals sees one target in Week 3
items.desc: Jalen Royals caught his only target for 11 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Royals remains minimally involved in the Kansas City offense early on, recording less than 15 receiving yards in each of his two contests. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tee Higgins finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 6-of-7 targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
items.impact: Higgins was just behind Ja'Marr Chase in targets, receptions, and receiving yards in the loss Sunday. He found the end zone for the first time this season on an impressive 28-yard reception prior to halftime. Higgins and the Bengals will welcome the Jaguars to town in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase excellent in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 9-of-12 targets for 98 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
items.impact: Chase led the team in all of the receiving categories for the Bengals Sunday. Chase and Joe Burrow connected on a three-yard touchdown strike in the first quarter. Chase and the Bengals will take on the Jaguars in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brashard Smith catches one pass in Week 3
items.desc: Brashard Smith caught his only target for four yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Smith has been non-existent in the Kansas City offense to begin the season, recording his first target in three contests Sunday. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) suffers dislocated thumb, will get MRI
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) suffered a dislocated thumb in the Bucs game against the Minnesota Vikings. He will undergo an MRI. Before exiting, he completed 17-of-34 passes for 217 yards with a touchdown and a pick.
items.impact: Mayfield has been struggling so far this season, and now has an injury to boot. His MRI will reveal more of the extent to his injury, and how long he might be out. It's a tough blow for the Bucs, and it's likely Jaylon Daniels will receive a start next week.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Samaje Perine sees four touches in Week 3
items.desc: Samaje Perine tallied nine rushing yards on three carries in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards.
items.impact: Perine continues to serve as the primary backup behind Chase Brown, but has not logged enough volume to be on the fantasy radar. Fantasy managers can leave him on the wire ahead of a matchup with Jacksonville in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Chase Brown quiet in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Chase Brown rushed for 61 yards on 13 carries in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
items.impact: Brown saw a season low in rushing attempts and targets. Despite the lower volume against Pittsburgh, fantasy managers should expect Brown to remain the workhorse running back for the Bengals in Week 4 against the Jaguars.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Briningstool sees one target in Week 3
items.desc: Jake Briningstool failed to catch his only target in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Briningstool has seen minimal involvement in the Kansas City offense early on, recording one target or less in each of the first three games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 28-of-37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns in a 30-27 loss to the Bengals. He rushed for 13 yards on two carries.
items.impact: Burrow was excellent for the majority of the game Sunday, finding Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and Mike Gesicki for his three touchdown passes. The veteran did fumble on what would be the final drive for the Bengals, sealing the win for the Steelers. Burrow and the Bengals will welcome the Jaguars to town in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Lions D/ST allows 24 points in Week 3 win
items.desc: The Lions D/ST allowed 24 points, 321 passing yards, and 58 rushing yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Lions' defense tallied five sacks and forced a fumble from Geno Smith to seal the game late in the fourth quarter. The defense struggled against the pass, allowing an average of 8.7 yards per completion. The Lions will head to Carolina to take on the Panthers in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jake Bates perfect in Week 3 win
items.desc: Jake Bates connected on his lone field goal attempt and all four of his extra point attempts in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Bates was perfect after each touchdown and made his lone field goal from 30-yards out to open the scoring in the second quarter. Bates has yet to miss a kick this season and will take his perfect season on the road to Carolina in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Sam LaPorta tallies three receptions in Week 3
items.desc: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-4 targets for 44 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: LaPorta saw the bulk of the targets go to Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs in the win over the Jets. Fantasy managers will hope that LaPorta can become more involved against the Panthers in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa hauls in three passes in Week 3
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa caught 3-of-3 targets for 66 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: TeSlaa led the team in receiving yardage despite the limited volume. His three receptions and 66 yards both are season highs for the 24-year-old, and he will look to build on this performance in a road matchup against Carolina.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jameson Williams hauls in four passes in Week 3 win
items.desc: Jameson Williams caught 4-of-4 targets for 49 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Williams took a back seat in the offense Sunday with Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs dominating the targets against the Jets. Williams will look to become more involved in the offense in a Week 4 matchup with the Panthers.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown finds the end zone in Week 3 win
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 4-of-8 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
items.impact: St. Brown was not able to capitalize on his eight targets, but was able to help salvage the day with a touchdown in the second quarter. St. Brown now has five touchdowns through the first three games of the season and will look to build on a strong start to the season against the Panthers in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs tallies three touchdowns in Week 3 win
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed for 99 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He caught 7-of-8 targets for 65 yards and a touchdown.
items.impact: Gibbs continues to impress this season, tallying six touchdowns in his first three games of the season. He caught an 11-yard pass in the fourth quarter to put the Lions on top of the Jets to seal the win. Gibbs and the Lions will take on the Panthers in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 3
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 25-of-32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He also rushed for six yards on four carries.
items.impact: Goff found Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs through the air to help pace the Lions to a home win over the Jets. Goff has yet to throw an interception this year and has three straight multi-touchdown games to open the season. The Lions will take on the Panthers on the road in Week 4.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 31 points in Week 3 loss
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 31 points, 269 passing yards, and 131 rushing yards in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: The Jets' defense tallied two sacks of Jared Goff, but failed to force a turnover in the loss. They may have an easier matchup in Week 4 with Caleb Williams (hamstring) unlikely to play for the Bears.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jason Sanders perfect in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Jason Sanders made his lone field goal attempt and his lone extra point attempt in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Sanders connected on a 42-yard field goal attempt in the third quarter. This was Sanders' third straight elevation from the practice squad, so the team will have to sign him to the active roster if they want him to remain the kicker in Week 4 against the Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Harrison Butker misses field goal in Week 3
items.desc: Harrison Butker converted all three of his extra point attempts while missing 1-of-2 field goal attempts to finish with six points in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
items.impact: Butker continues a solid start to the season, recording six or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more stable options in all formats behind a revamped Kansas City offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ollie Gordon II reaches end zone in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 17 times for 41 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in all three of his targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 Week 3 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Gordon II took advantage of increased touches with De'Von Achane (knee) exiting early for head coach Jeff Hafley, posting more than three touches for the first time in three contests Sunday. The running back is in line to take over a No. 1 running back role with Achane expected to be sidelined for a significant amount of time according to Hafley, with a tough Week 4 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jeremy Ruckert finds the end zone in Week 3
items.desc: Jeremy Ruckert caught all five of his targets for 39 yards and a touchdown in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Ruckert caught a four-yard pass early in the fourth quarter for his first touchdown of the season. The 26-year-old will likely continue to serve as the second tight end as long as Mason Taylor (thumb) is forced to miss time.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Willis struggles in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Malik Willis completed 20-of-36 pass attempts for 210 yards and one interception while also rushing nine times for a team-leading 56 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3.
items.impact: Willis has struggled to make an impact behind center early on, passing for less than 230 yards in each of the first three contests. The quarterback's only value remains from a rushing standpoint in a disappointing Dolphins offense for head coach Jeff Hafley, with a Week 4 matchup against a tough Minnesota Vikings defense up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Washington sees seven touches in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Malik Washington hauled in five of his team-high 10 targets for 56 yards while also rushing twice for five yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 Week 3 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Washington has made the most of steady involvement as part of an underwhelming Miami passing attack, posting over 40 receiving yards in each of the first three games. The wideout remains another risky option in a disappointing Dolphins offense to this point, with a Week 4 contest against a disruptive Minnesota Vikings defense up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Bell leads pass-catchers in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
items.desc: Chris Bell hauled in four of his seven targets for 67 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 Week 3 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Bell found a way to make an impact, finishing with more than one reception for the first time in three contests Sunday. The wideout remains one of many pass-catchers difficult to trust in the Dolphins offense early on, with a Week 4 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Greg Dulcich catches five passes in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Greg Dulcich caught five of his seven targets for 55 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3.
items.impact: Dulcich has struggled to make an impact in the Miami offense early in the season, finishing with less than 20 receiving yards in two of three contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options held back by an underwhelming Dolphins offense to this point, with a Week 4 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.
